ops.title: Tests that sandbox HOME must also set DAEMONKIT_HOME (daemonkit >= v0.20.9)
ops.body:
daemonkit v0.20.9 resolves every home-derived durable path (launchd plist dir, stable program root, artifact store) through the passwd database via internal/realhome.Dir, and no longer reads $HOME. A test that only does t.Setenv("HOME", dir) therefore stops sandboxing daemonkit: it writes into the real home. In wave 1 that overwrote the real ~/.daemonkit/bin/synckitd with a Go test binary.

The seam is the env var DAEMONKIT_HOME (internal/realhome.EnvOverride), honored ahead of the passwd lookup with a logged warning. Every site that sets HOME for a test must set DAEMONKIT_HOME to the same directory. Non-daemonkit code still reads HOME, so pair them; never drop HOME.

Sites in synckit: daemon/service_test.go (via the useHome helper) and hostregistry/store_test.go TestRefreshKnownHostsCreatesSolePrivateTrustFile. Re-grep for Setenv("HOME" when adding tests.

Never export DAEMONKIT_HOME process-wide in CI or shell config: cc-orchestrate install-binary.sh uses the same name with a different meaning. An outer env DAEMONKIT_HOME=<scratch> on a gate run is a belt-and-braces guard only.
